title: Junior Reporting Analyst (fictional)
description: FICTIONAL ROLE - Example Harbor Reporting. Build repeatable Python and SQL reports from sales datasets. Check data validation rules, document assumptions with Git, and explain results with data visualization. Familiarity with pandas, SQLite and Streamlit is useful. Coursework or a documented personal project is acceptable. Communicate limitations clearly and never substitute unverified figures for missing data.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst (fictional)

Perform data cleaning and data visualization, document metric definitions, and communicate findings to business colleagues. Power Query and DAX are useful supporting skills.

title: Machine Learning Intern (fictional)
description: FICTIONAL ROLE - Example Orchard Research. Use Python, NumPy and scikit-learn to build reproducible machine learning experiments. Apply statistics and regression, document evaluation methods, and perform data cleaning. Present results with Matplotlib. Familiarity with PyTorch or TensorFlow is helpful but not essential.
